content.text:
信号-量化杂讯比（SQNR）用**分贝（dB）**表示。

依据：
- Wikipedia 词条 "Signal-to-quantization-noise ratio"：SQNR 常用分贝表示，近似公式写作 `SQNR|dB = P_xν + 6.02ν + 4.77`。https://browse.library.kiwix.org/content/wikipedia_en_all_maxi/Signal-to-quantization-noise_ratio
- Princeton 教程："The SQNR in dB is approximately equal to 6 times the number of bits"。https://www.cs.princeton.edu/courses/archive/fall08/cos436/sensors/node41.html
- ScienceDirect：定义 `SQNR_dB = 10 log10(Px/Pe)`。https://www.sciencedirect.com/topics/engineering/signal-to-quantization-noise-ratio
